title: Rochester, NY — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Rochester, NY: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Rochester is a city in NY with a population of 211,328. Flower City with Kodak history, universities, lake effect snow, and cheap housing. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.5.
